task: Place the four metal weights on the blue cart on the ramp.
stage_definition: The stage equals the number of metal weights visibly resting stably on the cart.

successful_boundaries.evidence: first weight released into cart and remains
second weight released into cart and remains
third weight released into cart and remains
fourth weight released into cart; task terminal

failed_attempts.reason: release completed but cart remains empty
release completed but cart remains empty
grasp/release retry; cart count remains two

human_repositioning.note: operator hand repositions weights after a failed attempt
operator hand repositions remaining weights between attempts
operator hand repositions the remaining weight after a failed attempt

review.boundary_rule: first right-gripper opening frame after a visually verified successful placement
review.note: Assistance repositions source weights only; successful cart placements are performed by the policy-controlled arm.
